title: Syracuse University Chancellor Haynie: ‘We will author our own future’
summary: Syracuse University Chancellor J. Michael Haynie responds to Wall Street Journal reporting on enrollment and financial challenges facing the institution, citing national higher education headwinds including international student restrictions. The opinion piece represents institutional leadership defense against external criticism regarding tuition costs, academic standing, and geographic location disadvantages.
